name: Ren Sato
bio:
Ren Sato's journey in motorsport began unconventionally, not behind the wheel, but amidst the intricate algorithms of race simulation software. His sharp analytical mind quickly caught the eye of a junior formula team, where he started as a data analyst before rapidly ascending to strategy roles. His innovative approaches to race management, particularly his data-driven pit stop strategies, led to a string of surprising victories for the underdog team. 

Following a short stint as a consultant for a Formula 1 team, Ren joined Manthey EMA as Team Principal, drawn to their commitment to pushing the boundaries of GT racing. He believes in empowering his team, fostering a collaborative environment where every member’s insights are valued. His calm demeanor during high-pressure situations, coupled with his meticulous attention to detail, makes him a formidable leader both in the garage and the boardroom. He is known to be meticulous when it comes to race preparation, and strives for perfection from himself and his team.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Ren has a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with data points.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of green tea before every race.
